newsitem.title: USA: PotlaTch to relocate headquarters, affecting 40 workers.
newsitem.headline: PotlaTch to relocate headquarters, affecting 40 workers.

text.p: Potlatch Corp. said Monday its board approved a plan to relocate its headquarters from San Francisco to Spokane, Wash., affecting about 40 employees who work in its San Francisco and Walnut Creek, Calif., offices.
A spokeswoman for the paper company said the employees have been offered positions in Spokane. Those who choose not to move will be offered a severance package.
Costs were not disclosed for the move, which is expected to be completed during the third quarter. It said the move will lower the company's administrative costs.
Potlach's stock rose 50 cents to $42.375 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
